title: Player and playlists
summary: One player for the whole app, with lyrics that follow the music, playlists of takes and the phone's own controls.
description: The Music tab is the library; playing is the player's job, and the music keeps going while the learner practises.

stories.as: a learner listening while doing something else
stories.want: the lyrics to follow the music and the phone's own controls to work

requirements.text: The player highlights the line being sung, with its English meaning under each Polish line; tapping a line jumps there.
A song without word timings shows its full lyrics instead.
Tapping a word in the lyrics shows its meaning, taken from words the app already has, with no model asked.
The screen stays on while the full-screen player is open and a song is playing.
Playlists hold takes, not songs; deleting a take removes it from every playlist.
Play and shuffle use one take per song, the one played most; a take played from a song's page plays on into the next song, never into the other take of the same song.
The player offers shuffle, repeat all and repeat one, and counts plays.
A take can be saved as a file through the system's save dialog, or on Android shared to another app.
On Android songs play through a native media service: lock screen and notification controls, headphone buttons, a pause when headphones are unplugged, and playback with the screen off.
The repeat mode is a setting of the device and does not sync.
